title: May Admin — Investigation Dashboard MVP
purpose: Build the first functional administrative workspace: a browser-based dashboard with 4 tabbed views consuming the admin_dashboard_data.js data bundle.

dashboard.architecture: Vanilla JS, no build tooling, no server, file:// protocol compatible

questionView.controls: Text search (QID/topic), section filter, health tier filter
questionView.tableColumns: QID, Section, Topic, State, Health (color bar + score), Defects, Investigations
questionView.detailExpansion: Identity block, health gauge, defect badges, linked challenges list, linked investigations list, CLI command reference

challengeView.tableColumns: Challenge ID, Type, Question, Triage Category, Status, Priority Score
challengeView.detailExpansion: Question link (clickable to Question View), triage info, linked investigations, linked recommendations, linked sessions

sessionView.tableColumns: Session ID, Title, Mode, Questions, Certified %, Outcomes (ch/rec/inv counts)
sessionView.detailExpansion: Series, date, mode, QID list (truncated at 30), challenge/recommendation/investigation IDs

recommendationView.tableColumns: REC-ID, Type, Severity, Status, Target QIDs count, Source Scan
recommendationView.detailExpansion: Description, lifecycle timeline, target QID list, target session, linked investigations

conditions.status: PASS — challenge detail links to question view

selfAssessment.criterion: S265 can execute all 11 workflow cases through this dashboard with 0 manual registry traversals
selfAssessment.result: READY — All entity types indexed with FK links. Question detail shows linked challenges and investigations. Challenge detail links to question. The dashboard provides the complete administrative workspace S262 authorized.
